# Changelog {.unnumbered}

This document is released as a series of versions. Each entry below records the
changes from the previous version. The most recent version is at the top.

## v1.0 — *(draft, in preparation)*

Initial release.

- CROCO configuration: `C04_I01_GLORYS_ERA5`, multi-year coverage (Jan 2015 onwards).
- WW3 configuration: `RUN_02` (one-way coupled to CROCO surface currents and water levels), Jan–Dec 2016.
- Skill assessment for sea surface temperature against OSTIA, water level against tide gauges at Salmiya and Majis, significant wave height against CMEMS L3 satellite altimetry.
- Salinity reported as model-derived characterisation only.
- Currents not assessed.
